title: Rising Democratic star Jon Ossoff's reelection fuels presidential prospects
summary: Jon Ossoff's reelection Tuesday to the Senate in the southern state of Georgia will fuel speculation of a 2028 presidential run by one of the Democratic Party's young rising stars.
